v1_partner_counts_as_married.reason: SCF MARRIED is married or living with a partner (X8023 in 1-2); A_MARITL 1-2 drops cohabiting partners.

v2_children_of_reference_or_partner.reason: SCF KIDS counts children of the reference person or spouse/partner, any age, anywhere in the household listing.

v3_householder_couple_reference_person.reason: The SCF reference person comes from the economically dominant individual or couple (the man, or the older partner); the CPS householder anchors that unit, where the oldest adult can be a co-resident parent or roommate.

v4a_spm_unit_income.reason: SCF income covers the primary economic unit; the SPM unit is the CPS resource-sharing unit.

v4b_couple_and_children_income.reason: The PEU narrowed to the couple and their children.

r1_couple_income_drop_interest_dividends.reason: CPS interest and dividends are PUF-imputed at tax-unit level; at reference ages 25-34, 42% of host households have some against 16% of SCF families, so equal values do not mean equal positions.

r2_couple_income_drop_interest_dividends.reason: As r1, and Social Security or pension income: 18% of host households at 25-34 have some against 6% of SCF families.

r3_household_income_drop_interest_divide.reason: As r2 with the household income unit, to separate the two changes.
